{{Quote|I have come for Dequc. The rest of you should leave. Now.|Mara Jade|<ref name="Mara Jade" />}}
The '''Battle of Svivren''' was a skirmish between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the [[Svivreni resistance]] and the [[Black Nebula (organization)|Black Nebula]] taking place just before the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]].

==Background==
{{Quote|Dequc is a Jeodu who is seeking to revive Black Sun. He calls his organization Black Nebula and is on Svivren to negotiate with small criminal cartels and arms dealers.|[[K3]]|<ref name="Mara Jade" />}}
In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], [[Dequc]], a crime lord, wanted to negotiate with other scoundrels to create a new crime syndicate, the [[Black Nebula (organization)|Black Nebula]]. At that time, the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] had been unable to deal with crime and rebellion in the planet [[Svivren/Legends|Svivren]]; [[Cevva Xuz]], a criminal linked with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], thrived in Svivren with the [[Svivreni resistance]]. Dequc decided to visit Svivren and make operations there. However, [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] sent [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]], one of the [[Emperor's Hand/Legends|Emperor's Hands]], to the planet Svivren with the specific goal of murdering Dequc, as Dequc was more protected in his previous headquarters.<ref name="Mara Jade" />

==The battle==
{{Quote|I don't need your help and I don't want it. Stand back, I'm going in here.|Mara Jade, to Captain Strok|<ref name="Mara Jade" />}}
[[File:DequcsDecoySlashed-MaraJadeByTheEmperorsHand2.png|thumb|right|210px|Mara Jade executes Dequc's decoy.]]
Jade contacted the local Imperial garrison, led by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Touno]], and identified herself as an Imperial operative, requesting their help to apprehend Xuz. This was a feint, as she really intended to go after Dequc while the Imperials and the Rebels were fighting. Touno assigned several [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] and [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Strok (Galactic Empire)|Strok]] (who was secretly an agent of the Black Nebula) to arrest Xuz. As Strok was in Dequc's payroll, he notified his real employer, and Dequc left, leaving behind a decoy. From the middle of the street, Strok asked for Xuz's surrender. Xuz's Rebel forces answered by firing against the stormtroopers. Meanwhile, Jade executed Dequc's decoy. The battle took the lives of several stormtroopers and civilians. Jade then piloted a ship and left Svivren. Strok had to leave the planet soon afterward.<ref name="Mara Jade" />

==Aftermath==
Although she thought her mission was successful, Mara Jade later discovered that her target was a decoy and Dequc was still alive. She eventually [[Mission to Qiaxx|executed]] him several months later after the death of The Emperor, her master, at the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]].<ref name="Mara Jade" />
